inconsistencies: ArgsManager chain, order matters: #16545 (base) → #17580 → #17783 and #17493 → #17581. Reviewing #16545 first is what unblocks the rest; #17493 was banded below #17783 even though both close the same class of silent-configuration hazard, so they now share P2.

Logging chain, order matters: #34778 (base) → #29256 → #30342 → #30343. #34778 was P3 while its dependent #29256 was P2; the unresolved concept NACK on #34778 is the single thing stalling the whole stack, so it is now P2 and reviewed first.

Competing designs for the same problem: #34038 (-trace replacing -loglevel), #35387 (standalone -loglevel plus runtime RPC), and #35355 (also deprecates -loglevel for -trace). #34730 is explicitly stacked on #34038. Review #34038 first and settle the interface; the other three should not be reviewed on their own merits until then.
Overlapping implementations: #35355 and #35322 both replace the Logger category level map/mutex with atomic bitmasks. One of them should be dropped or rebased on the other.

Conflicting direction on low-level I/O failures: #35676 makes CheckDiskSpace/FlatFileSeq::Open abort on filesystem_error, while #36049 removes an abort path on buffered write failure (and #36210 enriches the thrown errors). These three should be decided together; #36049 is the one with a reproduced real-world failure.
util::Result chain: #25665 (base) → #26022 → #25722. Review #25665 first; #25722 is the only one with a user-facing surface, and it is last in the chain.

Silent payments: #35301 is the 'take 2' foundation that #35302 builds on, while #32966 (receiving) predates it. Check whether #32966 is superseded by or must be rebased onto #35301 before spending review time on it.
#36105 contains the Windows ExecVp fix; #36190 only adds tests for it. Review #36105 first.
#36278, #36282 and #36298 are three subtree bumps all justified solely by unblocking #36275 (-Wunused-const-variable). Same consequence, same band; review as one batch.
#36295 removes the overload helpers that #31260 needs disambiguated; it is trivially small but should be looked at alongside #31260 rather than independently.

#35461 and #36087 both change unreachable/assert diagnostics (NONFATAL_UNREACHABLE vs AssertUnreachable) and #35461 originates from review feedback on #34844; coordinate the three so the macro semantics land once.
result.notes: This category is dominated by long author-stacked chains (ArgsManager, logging, util::Result, silent payments, multiprocess IPC); several bands were adjusted purely so a base never sits below what it unblocks. The P2 band is large because the category's subject is shared infrastructure, but it is kept distinct from P3: P2 holds live defects in primitives, measured speedups, and bases of multi-PR projects, while P3 holds deferrable cleanups, platform/diagnostic polish, and subtree bumps.
